answers.answer_text: I used to work in Seattle.
Did you used to speak Bengali?

questions_and_answers.question_text: जब आप यहाँ थे, तब आपके दोस्त आये थे ।

answers.answer_text: When you were here, did your friends come?

questions_and_answers.question_text: जब हम भारत में थे, तो मेरी बेटी काफी हिन्दी बोलती थी ।

answers.answer_text: When we were in India, my daughter used to speak quite a lot of Hindi.

questions_and_answers.question_text: जहाँ आजकल वे रहते हैं वहाँ पहले मैं रहता था ।

answers.answer_text: I used to live where they live nowadays.

questions_and_answers.question_text: जहाँ आपका मकान है, वहाँ पहले एक स्कूल होता था ।

answers.answer_text: There used to be a school where your house is.

questions_and_answers.question_text: पिछले साल आप कहाँ काम करते थे ?

answers.answer_text: Where did you work last year?

answers.answer_text: When you were in India, did you speak Hindi?

questions_and_answers.question_text: जब वहाँ रहती थी, पंजाबी बोलती थी ।

answers.answer_text: When I lived there, I used to speak Punjabi.

questions_and_answers.question_text: पहले बम्बई में रहते थे, लेकिन आजकल यहां रहते हैं ।

answers.answer_text: Formerly we lived in Bombay, but nowadays we live here.
